_help: Shared defaults. Don't put your own bills here: the app creates config.local.json next to it on first run ("folder": "./", every bill found set to "monthly"), and that file overrides this one.

"folder": where the bill files are, used when config.local.json doesn't set one. "./" = the folder the app is in. Also accepts a relative path ("./samples", "../2026"), an absolute path, or "~/...". The PDF (bills-overview.output.pdf) is written there too.
"bills": which months each bill is expected. Bills not listed (or null) are shown but never flagged.
A key also covers every bill that starts with it: "Meter 01" covers "Meter 01 Photo 1 Before" etc. The longest matching key wins. Keys in config.local.json replace the same keys here.
